title: Growing Reddit - Web Development
summary: A short clip from Udacity's Web Development course in which Reddit co-founder Steve Huffman describes how Reddit grew early on. He explains seeding the site with content from fake accounts.
why: HN cites it as a first-hand admission from a founder of how Reddit seeded content with fake users, in threads on bootstrapping user-generated sites.

quote.text: Steve Huffman talks about this in his Udacity course on web development
